$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the EC Battery Passport guidance data-point registry. Transcribed from the European Commission 'Guidance Document: Digital Batteries Passport - data points by category', Version 3.2, 19 October 2026 (DG GROW Unit G2, CC BY 4.0), which supersedes Version 1.0 of 28 July 2026 (Ares(2026)7579758). scripts/build-ec-guidance-vocab.ts generates vocab/ec-battery-passport-guidance-<version>.ttl, validation/ec-datapoint-applicability.json, validation/ec-readiness-shapes.ttl and docs/EC_GUIDANCE_DATAPOINTS.md from this file. 'name' is the guidance's data point name with its clarifications in square brackets; 'definedIn' is its 'As defined in' column; 'source' cites the Batteries Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 provision named in the 'Data point source' column; 'typeOfInformation' is the guidance's 'Type of information' column verbatim (new in version 3.2). 'accessTier' is the same information as a token: public (Article 77(3), Annex VI A, Annex XIII 1), legitimateInterest (Annex XIII 2 and 4), notifiedBodiesAndAuthorities (Annex XIII 3); it agrees with Article 77(2) for every data point. 'lifecycle' encodes the document's static/dynamic split: Annex XIII 4 data points (51-71) are dynamic (served by the EPCIS event stream folded into the item passport); everything else is static master data served by the GS1 Digital Link resolver. Applicability statuses: mandatory | optional | conditional | notToBeFilled (redundant per the guidance) | pending (not to be filled/displayed as of February 2027 because the format, the application date or the application provisions are not yet set); 'note' quotes the guidance cell verbatim whenever it says more than the status. 'renumbering' maps the version 1.0 numbers to version 3.2.
